info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Retail Orders Cancel-v3-spec
info.description: The Cancel Retail Orders API allows users to efficiently manage order cancellations within the retail system. This API endpoint enables the deletion of existing retail orders, facilitating the correction of customer orders or adjustments in inventory management. Typical consumers include retail staff and automated systems concerned with order processing and customer service functionalities. With robust features to handle cancellations, this API supports seamless customer experience and operational agility.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to cancel an order that you have previously placed. Ensure that the order ID is valid and that the order is eligible for cancellation based on its current status.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details required to cancel an order. It must contain the necessary information identifying the order to be canceled, ensuring that the operation can be processed correctly.

DeleteRetailOrdersCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for cancelling an order operation.

DeleteRetailOrdersCancelResponse_200.title: Cancel Order Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancel operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the order.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the order after the cancel operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancel operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancel operation.

DeleteRetailOrdersCancelResponse_200.description: Response schema for the Cancel Order operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user who created the order.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the order was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the order was created automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Contains information about who created the order and when.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the processing time in milliseconds for the DELETE request operation.
